description: Revised deletion patch still violated the binding keep-two-files ruling.
Submitted verification output contained claims not reproducible from the checked-in scripts.
A synthetic relay test did not exercise the real fatq-cli fallback path.
Bootstrap swallowed all secret-read failures instead of only the documented missing-secret case.
The helper source still hard-coded the production checkout after only the destination was isolated.
The real notification fixture copied an untracked notifier absent from the task clone.
The audit report invented a third UI label absent from screenshots and repository text.
The gate script failed when run bare because its default identity lacked admin access.
A display-data refactor silently changed the authorization source for project creation.
A Bash local self-reference crashed the required HTTP fixture before its first request.
Cleanroom evidence probed the attachment sub-router and returned 404 for all application endpoints.
Same-command environment assignments wrote users.db into the source tree instead of the isolated directory.
The required create-note HTTP fixture crashed under set -u due to a local self-reference.
One supposedly original companion retained the reference character's distinctive silhouette.
The patch removed two submit-lock tests without disclosing the reduced test count.
Required raw red-light outputs were swallowed by grep and never delivered.
A modal covered the page, making all five required viewport screenshots invalid evidence.
The prop was clipped by overflow at all three tested mobile viewports.
A stale ImageMagick gravity setting cropped the required comparison preview.
A fixture checked one sprite although global CSS broke four other stage sprites.
The registered live probe named a nonexistent script while the delivered fixture used another filename.
A new routing block duplicated a hard-coded pool table and recreated multiple sources of truth.
An optimization hid nested repositories and its held-fd fixture never reached the intended branch.
Failure notification network calls had no timeout and could stall EXIT cleanup.
A customer-isolation patch removed the production GBRAIN_URL override outside its customer-only branch.
The inventory scanner could not see gitlinks or untracked writers and passed an injected unknown origin.
The hospital-state page still scrolled at all three required viewports and the declared patch hunk omitted a log line.
The feasibility report omitted a directly relevant official fix, recovery timing, and required raw process evidence.
One hundred twenty-five tests and two probes were green while a missing breaker config could still halt fleet dispatch.
Fixture setup always created a valid breaker config and eliminated the missing-config condition it purported to test.
Closeout recorded closed after only the shared half was active; the pod-system worker code had not been restarted.
fatq-verify mapfile split a command element containing newlines and could report PASS for a truncated no-op.
A valid host-applied document commit was structurally blocked from closeout after its create-time live-probe opt-out became stale.
Valid review work was blocked because task-authored verify commands used an invalid string schema.
The submit-time long verifier prevented a valid builder handoff until the verification stage was redesigned.
A later deployment invalidated the original no-live-probe premise and left valid work in a closeout deadlock.
